title: Attacker Hijacks AI Coding Assistant Session, Spreads Shai-Hulud Across About 100 Repositories
blurb: A compromised AI coding-assistant session let an attacker spread the Shai-Hulud worm across roughly 100 repositories, showing agentic dev tooling can become a supply-chain attack vector.

title: Trusting-Trust Attack against an Entire Linux Distribution through Binary Manipulation
blurb: A modern take on Ken Thompson's classic "trusting trust" attack shows a compiler-level backdoor can silently propagate through an entire Linux distribution's binaries.

title: GPUThor: Amplifying Rowhammer Attacks via Non-Uniform Patterns to Exploit ECC-Protected GPUs
blurb: Researchers extend Rowhammer to GPUs, using non-uniform hammering patterns to defeat ECC protection and flip bits in GPU memory.

title: "15 years ago, people understood it was an unfinished game": As Endless Legend 2 hits 1.0, Amplitude reflect on how early access has changed
blurb: Amplitude's founders reflect on how a decade and a half of early access has reshaped what players expect from an "unfinished" game.

title: Hyper Light studio Heart Machine lays off 'nearly everyone' after publishing deal for unannounced game falls through
blurb: Hyper Light Drifter studio Heart Machine lays off nearly its whole team after a publishing deal for an unannounced project collapsed.

title: Mobile trap transports 92 antiprotons by road and stores them for over a month in world first
blurb: Problem: Precisely comparing protons and antiprotons, to hunt for matter-antimatter asymmetry, is limited at CERN by magnetic-field noise from facility operations. Approach: The BASE collaboration loaded 92 antiprotons into BASE-STEP, a mobile Penning trap, then drove it about 8km around CERN by truck. Result: The antiprotons survived transport and were stored for over a month, with vacuum better than 2.2×10⁻¹⁸ mbar — the first road transport and longest open-trap antimatter storage on record. Why it matters: Portable antimatter storage lets physicists take precision measurements to quieter labs, chasing a matter-antimatter difference that could explain why the universe has any matter left at all. Glossary: Penning trap - electromagnetic device that confines charged particles. ppb - parts per billion, a precision unit. Matter-antimatter asymmetry - unexplained excess of matter over antimatter in the cosmos. mbar - millibar, a unit of vacuum pressure.

title: What happens when neutrinos swap identities inside a supernova?
blurb: Simulations of a core-collapse supernova show neutrinos swapping flavor identities mid-explosion, a process that could reshape models of how heavy elements form.

title: A 3D Rasterizer For Embedded Devices
blurb: Problem: Rendering real 3D graphics on a microcontroller is hard without dedicated GPU hardware or much memory. Approach: Jet is a dependency-free, integer-only C++17 software rasterizer built for chips like the ESP32 and STM32, targeting RGB565 SPI displays. Result: On an ESP32-S3 it renders about 650 post-culled triangles at 60fps (1300 at 30fps) on a 480×320 display — performance the developers place between the Sega 32X and Saturn. Why it matters: It brings real-time 3D to sub-$20 microcontrollers with no GPU, opening the door to retro-style 3D on badges and embedded builds. Glossary: Rasterizer - converts 3D triangles into pixels. RGB565 - 16-bit packed color format. SPI - serial bus used to drive small displays. Post-culling - triangles left after removing hidden/off-screen ones.

title: Original Sony PlayStation 2 security chip 'broken wide open' after 26 years
blurb: A reverse-engineering enthusiast cracked Sony's PS2 security chip wide open after 26 years, exposing the console's copy-protection secrets for good.

title: Training a 4B model to produce 81% faster query plans than Postgres
blurb: A 4B-parameter model trained specifically on query planning produces plans 81% faster than Postgres's own planner, hinting at learned components replacing hand-tuned database heuristics.
